title: Women's Basketball Final Beat Men's Final By 4.08 Million Viewers
hook: Women's basketball drew the bigger championship audience.
closing: Women's basketball turned a bigger audience into bigger crowds and media value.
question: Did you watch the women's final?

segments.say: Women's basketball drew 18.9 million viewers, more than the men's final.
Women's basketball attendance reached 2.37 million, showing the audience kept growing after television.
Women's basketball media rights reached 200 million dollars yearly, turning audience growth into revenue.
